notes.text: Cyber Governance is the intersection of applied cyber technologies, regulatory frameworks, and strategic approaches tailored to meet the specific requirements of businesses. This minor equips students with the skills needed to develop robust security methodologies and frameworks that foster the optimal functioning of security processes and systems.
